title: Transcript
description: eclume transcript, contract v1. It is the body of `GET /api/v1/transcripts/{transcript_id}` and the output of the GPU worker. It evolves only additively: the consumer ignores properties it does not know and tolerates new enum values (rules in contracts/README.md).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema, `1.<minor>`. The minor goes up with every additive change; 1.2 marks `owner` as deprecated.

id.description: Transcript id. Stable across revisions and retranscriptions.

recorded_at.description: Recording start (RFC 3339). Without a date supplied by the client, it is the upload instant.

source.description: How the audio reached eclume: `desktop` (capture app), `upload` (browser) or `api` (integration through a PAT).

content_hash.description: Hash of the uploaded audio file, `sha256:<hex>`. It is the deduplication key of the upload and of the import into lumea.

revision.description: Content revision. It goes up with every edit (speaker renamed, person linked, segment corrected) and with every retranscription.

updated_at.description: Last change to any field; it is what `GET /api/v1/transcripts?since=` compares.

owner.description: Deprecated since schema 1.2: always the user themselves (each account is isolated); removed in version 2 of the schema.

speakers.description: Speakers of the transcript. Without diarization, there is a single speaker.

segments.description: Utterances in `start_ms` order. Every `speaker_id` points to a speaker in `speakers`.

kind.description: Nature of the recording: `meeting` (meeting) or `note` (voice note). Since schema 1.1.

recorded_at_source.description: Where `recorded_at` came from: `capture` (clock of the app that recorded), `file_metadata` (file metadata, confirmed at import), `user` (supplied or corrected) or `upload` (upload time). Since schema 1.1.

UserRef.description: Short reference to an eclume user.

PersonRef.description: Short reference to a person in the organization's directory.

SpeakerSuggestion.description: Person suggested for a speaker by the voiceprint. Only the account's automatic assignment (`Speaker.auto_score`) links without confirmation, and only above its threshold.

id.description: Speaker id, unique within the transcript (`S1`, `S2`...). Stable across edits; disappears only in a merge.

label.description: Display name. It starts as `Locutor N` and changes when the user renames the speaker.

person.description: Person linked to the speaker, or `null` while nobody has identified them. It comes from a human confirmation or, with `auto_score`, from the automatic assignment by voice.

auto_score.description: Score (normalized cosine, 0 to 1) with which the voice linked the speaker to the `person` at ingestion, when the account's automatic assignment was on; `null` if someone linked or confirmed the link, and always `null` without `person`. Confirming (`PATCH` with the same `person_id`) clears it and only then reinforces the voiceprint.

suggestions.description: Voice suggestions not yet confirmed, from highest to lowest `score`.

talk_ms.description: Total speaking time of the speaker, in milliseconds.

Word.description: Word with alignment timing. `start_ms` and `end_ms` are `null` when the aligner could not place it (numbers, acronyms).

Segment.description: One continuous utterance by a speaker. `end_ms >= start_ms`.

id.description: Segment id, unique within the transcript.

speaker_id.description: Speaker of the utterance; points to `speakers[].id`.

confidence.description: Average ASR confidence in the segment, from 0 to 1.

TranscriptEngine.description: Provenance: engine and models that produced the transcript.
